rungs.title: Junior Interaction Designer
rungs.summary: Learning flows, states and how people actually use interfaces.
rungs.knowledge: Knows usability heuristics, common patterns and the prototyping tools.
rungs.delivery: Designs screens and simple flows to a brief, with review on everything.
rungs.leadership: Shows work early and asks developers what is feasible.

rungs.title: Interaction Designer
rungs.summary: Designs complete flows, states and behaviours.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in flows, states, accessibility and the design system; understands what front end can build.
rungs.delivery: Takes a problem to a tested, specified flow with light review.
rungs.leadership: Facilitates feedback sessions and hands over clearly to developers.

rungs.title: Senior Interaction Designer
rungs.summary: Owns the interaction model of a product.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in research methods and motion; designs for AI features and edge cases.
rungs.delivery: Owns the interaction model of a product and proves it with users.
rungs.leadership: Mentors, runs critiques and aligns product, engineering and design.

rungs.title: Lead Interaction Designer
rungs.summary: Leads the interaction practice and its quality.
rungs.knowledge: Sets the patterns and principles every product follows.
rungs.delivery: Owns interaction quality across products and plans the design work.
rungs.leadership: Leads designers and represents interaction design in product decisions.

rungs.title: Head of Interaction Design
rungs.knowledge: Connects experience quality to business results and brand.
rungs.delivery: Owns the experience strategy and the design budget.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and speaks for the user at the executive table.
